deviation: The draft replaces the standard's general "breach of law" indemnity with Helix's breach of Article 5 or Article 6 only. Helix would not cover third-party claims from legal breaches outside those Articles, and the playbook makes breach-of-law cover mandatory with no fallback. The IP and gross negligence limbs match the standard, and the draft adds wilful misconduct, Affiliates and defence costs, which favour Arcadia.
suggested_text: 9.1 By Helix. Helix shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Arcadia, its Affiliates and their personnel from third-party claims, and resulting losses, damages and reasonable costs, arising from (a) allegations that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Helix's breach of any applicable law or regulation (including, without limitation, its obligations under Article 5 and Article 6); or (c) Helix's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. 9.2 Procedure. [unchanged]
